title: 第21章 此景只应天上有第22章 得加钱先给钱
slug: 玄幻开局吃软饭出世即儒圣
content_zh:
沈无名疲于应对这些人，可同时，心中还产生了一种莫名其妙感觉。
在解决了这些问题之后，他体内的墨家法力，居然愈发的强盛。
【你与墨家修士交流算术之道、炼金之道，大有收获，‘墨经’突破第五重】
到底怎么回事？
从能量守恒来说，最起码要摄入什么能量，才能换取修为的增长吧。
可此时……仿佛就像是悟道一样，凭空增加了自己的修为。
等到裴茂都亲自过来后，沈无名周围的人才逐渐散开。
“裴大人！”
沈无名微微鞠躬行礼，这可是二品巨头，仅次于宰相的大人物。
就算六部尚书，与尚书左丞也不过是平级而已。
“后院聊聊？”裴茂主动邀请，沈无名自然乐意之至。
要是再不走的话，自己就要被眼前这帮家伙给累死了，一个个的，简直是魔怔人！
朝后方走去的间隙，沈无名也打开了自己的系统面板。
【宿主：沈无名】
【技能：诗经（lv5）、墨经（lv5）、说文解字（lv3）、道教义枢（lv1）、秦越人切脉法（lv2）、踏海镇龙诀（lv1）】
沈无名觉得很奇葩。
自己一门心思苦修的诗经，也就在前两日才突破第五重，成就第五境修士。
可这墨经凭什么呀？
他心中一直不在意墨家修行，可如今修行的速度丝毫不慢。
甚至让他心中都已经产生了些许动摇。

若是自己真的主修墨经，会不会速度更快？说不定都第六境了。
不过想了片刻，他还是摇摇头。
他现在修行速度快，只是将未来科学家几千年的成果一股脑说出来。
可到了后边，需要走出自己道路的时候，那可就不是一回事了。
科学界的确有许多可以抄，但界就少了？李杜诗篇万口传，至今已绝不新鲜。
光是唐宋时代的璀璨诗词，估计都能将他的修为推上七八境！
“小友摇头，莫非我裴家的布置有什么问题？”
裴茂带着沈无名和曹茱萸穿过长廊，来到后院，见到沈无名摇头，不由得笑问道。
“不敢不敢。”沈无名回过神来，哑然失笑。
“能够在这北国见到江南风光，已经是意外之喜！”
“而且器物雅而不奢，造景风禾尽起！”
“此景只应天上有，人间难得几回观？”
裴茂闻言，并没有因为沈无名的夸赞而有所欣喜，反而脸色逐渐严肃下去。
曹茱萸倒是有些疑惑，沈无名这句话也没有丢了体面，为什么裴茂还有点不高兴？
沈无名本是神情淡淡，瞥了一眼裴茂，心中也有些疑惑。
不就是夸了一下他家的园子好看吗，为什么突然就变得这么严肃？
给自己选脸色？下马威？
沈无名有些不解，但见他没有说话，自然也不会主动挑起话。
目光打量着这裴家后院，暮光最终落在旁边的小桥流水。
在围栏边上有一排钻了洞的袋子，会时不时放出饲料，引得池中金鱼追食。

游览者站在池边的时候，就像有万千金鱼朝拜一般，的确颇为雅致。
“此景只应天上有，人间难得几回观？好啊，这句话说得好啊。”
content_en:
Shen Wuming was tired of dealing with these people, but at the same time, he felt an inexplicable feeling in his heart.
After solving these problems, the Mohist magic power in his body became stronger and stronger.
[You have gained a lot from exchanging arithmetic and alchemy with Mohist monks, and the ‘Mo Jing’ has broken through to the fifth level]
What's going on?
From the perspective of energy conservation, at least what amount of energy should be taken in in order to gain growth in cultivation.
But at this time... it was as if he had gained enlightenment, increasing his cultivation level out of thin air.
After Pei Maodu arrived in person, the people around Shen Wuming gradually dispersed.
"Master Pei!"
Shen Wuming bowed slightly and saluted. This was a second-level giant, second only to the prime minister.
Even the six ministers are just on the same level as the minister Zuo Cheng.
"Let's chat in the backyard?" Pei Mao invited him proactively, and Shen Wuming was naturally happy to do so.
If he didn't leave, he would be exhausted to death by the guys in front of him. They were all so crazy!
While walking towards the back, Shen Wuming also opened his system panel.
[Host: Shen Wuming]
[Skills: Book of Songs (lv5), Mo Jing (lv5), Shuowen Jiezi (lv3), Taoist teachings (lv1), Qinyue people's pulse-taking method (lv2), Sea-stepping Dragon Suppression Technique (lv1)]
Shen Wuming thought it was strange.
The Book of Songs, which I devoted myself to studying, had only broken through to the fifth level in the past two days and became a fifth-level monk.
But why is this Mo Jing based on it?
He has never cared about the Mohist practice in his heart, but now the speed of practice is not slow at all.
It even made him feel a little shaken in his heart.
If I really majored in Mo Jing, would it be faster? Maybe it’s the sixth realm.
But after thinking for a moment, he shook his head.
He is practicing at a fast pace now, and he is just telling the results of thousands of years of future scientists.
But later on, when you need to find your own path, that's not the same thing.
There is indeed much that can be copied in the scientific world, but there is less in the world of science? Li Du's poems have been passed down by thousands of mouths, and they are by no means new to this day.
Just the splendid poems from the Tang and Song Dynasties could probably push his cultivation to the seventh or eighth level!
"My little friend shook his head, is there something wrong with the layout of my Pei family?"
Pei Mao led Shen Wuming and Cao Juyu through the corridor and came to the backyard. When he saw Shen Wuming shaking his head, he couldn't help but ask with a smile.
"Don't dare." Shen Wuming came back to his senses and laughed dumbly.
“It’s an unexpected joy to be able to see the scenery of the south of the Yangtze River in this northern country!”
"Moreover, the utensils are elegant but not extravagant, and the landscaping is full of charm!"
"This scene can only be seen in heaven. How many times can it be seen on earth?"
When Pei Mao heard this, he was not happy because of Shen Wuming's praise, but his face gradually became serious.
Cao Juyu was a little confused. Shen Wuming's words did not disgrace him. Why was Pei Mao still a little unhappy?
Shen Wuming's expression was indifferent. He glanced at Pei Mao and felt a little confused.
Wasn't it just that he praised the beauty of his garden? Why did he suddenly become so serious?
Choose a face for yourself? Show off your power?
Shen Wuming was a little puzzled, but seeing that he didn't speak, he naturally didn't take the initiative to start a conversation.
Looking at the Pei family's backyard, the twilight finally fell on the small bridge and flowing water next to it.
There is a row of bags with holes drilled next to the fence, and feed will be released from time to time, attracting the goldfish in the pond to chase the food.
When visitors stand by the pool, they feel like thousands of goldfish are worshiping, which is indeed quite elegant.
"This scene can only be seen in the sky. How many times can you see it on earth? Okay, this is a good saying."
